description:
What is This Part?
These are the Suzuki OEM Engine Lift Hook.
Connects to the Engine for Removing
Replaces the old style hook, which was smaller & weaker
60% More Weight Lifting Capacity Than Old Style Hook
Easier to Connect to a Chain than Old Style Hooks
2″ Wide x 4″ Tall
4mm Thick Steel compared to the Old Style Hook of 2mm Thick
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Engine Hook
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
